channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Depois de fala de Milei, Itamaraty convoca embaixador argentino para expressar repulsa
item.description: The Brazilian Foreign Ministry summoned Argentina's ambassador to express repulsion over Javier Milei's attacks on President Lula during a private visit to São Paulo on July 25. Brazil also recalled its ambassador in Buenos Aires for consultations, underscoring its objection to foreign leaders making democratic institution insults on Brazilian soil.

item.title: Itamaraty convoca embaixador da Argentina para 'transmitir repulsa' do governo sobre xingamentos de Milei
item.description: The Brazilian government summoned Argentina's ambassador to convey its repudiation of President Javier Milei's insults toward President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes during the PL party convention in São Paulo. The Itamaraty described the remarks as unprecedented and regrettable, emphasizing the diplomatic protocol violation for occurring on Brazilian soil. Brazil also recalled its ambassador in Buenos Aires, Julio Bitelli, for consultations following the incident.

item.title: União Brasil oficializa candidatura de Allyson Bezerra ao governo do RN
item.description: União Brasil officially launched Allyson Bezerra's candidacy for governor of Rio Grande do Norte at a convention in Natal's Djalma Maranhão Sports Palace. Her ticket includes state deputy Hermano Morais (MDB) as vice-governor, and Bezerra stated she will maintain neutrality in the presidential race, avoiding ties with Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro. The state election also features Cadu Xavier (PT), Álvaro Dias (PL), and Robério Paulino (PSOL).

item.title: Itamaraty convoca embaixador da Argentina no Brasil para prestar esclarecimentos e chama fala de Milei de 'lamentável'
item.description: The Brazilian Ministry of Foreign Affairs summoned Argentina's ambassador to express the government's rejection of President Javier Milei's remarks at the PL convention, where he attacked Brazilian democratic institutions and Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Milei also praised Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy and linked it to a purported liberal 'blue wave' across Latin America. Brazil also recalled its ambassador in Argentina for consultations, indicating a serious diplomatic signal amid rising bilateral tensions.

item.title: Presidente da Câmara do Paraguai acusa Lula de tratar guerra de “forma leviana”
item.description: The president of Paraguay's Chamber of Deputies, Raúl Latorre, accused Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva of treating the Paraguayan War lightly, after Lula claimed that Paraguay 'decided to invade' Brazil during a speech on defense investments. Lula's statement drew criticism from Paraguayan lawmakers, who viewed it as a historical distortion and a disrespect to the memory of the 1864-1870 conflict. Latorre urged respect for history and emphasized that the war was an aggression by Argentina, Brazil, and Uruguay against Paraguay.

item.title: Caiado diz que participará de todos os debates e cobra adversários
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado confirmed he will participate in all presidential debates during the PSD convention in São Paulo, using the opportunity to criticize Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for prioritizing vanity and power over concrete results. He emphasized his clean political trajectory and governance experience to differentiate himself from the leading candidates in the polls.

item.title: O que discursos e presença de Milei em convenção revelam sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PL convention launching Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign revealed a disoriented effort, relying on anti-PT sentiment and the image of Jair Bolsonaro without offering original proposals or personal charisma. Javier Milei’s participation, delivering similar rhetoric with greater energy, overshadowed Flávio and reinforced perceptions of foreign interference, alienating independent and centrist voters. The event failed to expand his base and may bolster Lula’s narrative on national sovereignty, as anti-PT and anti-Bolsonarism remain dominant forces in Brazilian politics.

item.title: No ABC, Lula pede que metalúrgicos mantenham tradição de luta
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) urged metalworkers in the ABC region to maintain their tradition of struggle and independent government oversight during the inauguration of Moisés Selerges at the ABC Metalworkers' Union. He emphasized that union leaders must represent their base even when holding public office and defended union autonomy as vital to democracy. Lula also stated Brazil will continue pursuing sovereign economic policies without foreign interference, referencing diplomatic tensions with the United States.

item.title: Lula publica no Washington Post artigo para o eleitor brasileiro ler
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva published an article in the Washington Post, primarily addressing the Brazilian electorate. The secondary objective was to ensure his message reached American households and the White House, aiming to shape international perception of his administration.

item.title: Governador de Buenos Aires posta foto com Lula e critica Milei
item.description: Buenos Aires Province Governor Axel Kicillof posted a photo alongside President Lula and criticized Argentine President Javier Milei’s remarks, in which Milei insulted the Brazilian government during a PL convention in São Paulo. Kicillof defended regional integration and stated that Milei’s comments do not reflect the views of the Argentine people, warning that such provocations endanger investments, exports, and jobs. Brazil’s Foreign Ministry recalled its ambassador to Argentina for consultations in response to the offense.

item.title: Haddad sugere enviar Tarcísio ao exterior para defender urnas eletrônicas
item.description: Fernando Haddad, PT candidate for São Paulo governor, criticized Argentine President Javier Milei's remarks against Brazilian authorities and defended the security of Brazil's electronic voting machines, stating the system is internationally recognized. He sarcastically suggested sending São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas abroad to defend the credibility of the voting machines.

item.title: Eduardo Leite promete palanque forte para Caiado no RS
item.description: Rio Grande do Sul Governor Eduardo Leite (PSD) pledged to deliver a 'strong platform' in the state for Ronaldo Caiado's (PSD) presidential campaign during a PSD presidential campaign during the party's event in São Paulo that formalized Caiado's candidacy. Leite said he will present proposals focused on economic development and public security, advocating a policy of respecting differences and building convergences. He also endorsed Gabriel Souza (MDB) as his successor in RS, as he cannot seek re-election due to term limits.

item.title: Lula lança novo jingle de campanha inspirado em "Rap do Silva"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva launched a new campaign jingle inspired by the 1990s 'Rap do Silva' by funk artist Bob Rum, which narrates his life story from rural northeastern Brazil to the presidency, emphasizing his resilience and diplomatic engagement. The jingle was released on Sunday, July 26, and features footage of Lula meeting with international leaders, including Donald Trump. The effort aims to strengthen his image as a worker and defender of the nation amid political criticism and tensions.

item.title: Milei acusa Brasil, México e democratas dos EUA de financiar ‘campanha anti-argentina’
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei accused Brazil, Mexico, and the U.S. Democratic Party of funding an 'anti-Argentina' campaign without providing evidence, in an interview with radio Mitre. The remarks come amid diplomatic tensions after Brazil denied his request to visit jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro and following his speech at the Liberal Party convention in São Paulo, where he referred to Lula as a 'prisoner' and Alexandre de Moraes as 'bald trash'. Milei also suggested the Lula government had supported Argentina's opposition in past elections.

item.title: Haddad reage a ataque de Milei a Alexandre de Moraes: "Desrespeitoso"
item.description: Fernando Haddad criticized Argentine President Javier Milei for calling Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes a 'bald trash', stating that the behavior is completely incompatible with Brazil-Argentina relations and represents disrespect toward Brazilian institutions. He compared the situation to a hypothetical visit by President Lula to Argentina, saying it would be unthinkable for a Brazilian to disrespect authorities of a neighboring country.

item.title: Ouça o jingle da campanha de Caiado à Presidência
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado launched his presidential campaign jingle on July 26, 2026, emphasizing his honesty, decency, and commitment to the people. The song, presented at the PSD convention in São Paulo, highlights proposals to combat crime, expand healthcare and education, and claims Caiado is 'the most praised governor in the country' and 'a 1000/10'. Gilberto Kassab was confirmed as his vice-presidential running mate.

item.title: Lula lança jingle de campanha inspirado em “Rap do Silva”
item.description: Lula launched a campaign jingle inspired by MC Bob Rum's 'Rap do Silva', adapting its lyrics to narrate his journey from the northeastern backlands to the presidency, emphasizing his identity as a worker, family man, and advocate for the poor. The song references housing, food, and employment programs, as well as efforts to silence him, transforming the original chorus into 'É o Lula da Silva, é a estrela que brilha'. The 1995 original told the story of a worker killed after a funk dance, becoming a symbol of marginalized Brazilians.

item.title: PT entra com ações no TSE e no STF contra mensagem de Bolsonaro em vídeo de IA
item.description: The Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PV and PCdoB) filed actions with the TSE and STF against an AI-generated video shown at the PL convention, in which Jair Bolsonaro’s image and voice were used to support his son Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy. The PT argues the video constitutes premature electoral propaganda, improper use of AI, and violation of a court order barring Bolsonaro from political commentary due to his criminal conviction and house arrest. The federation seeks a R$ 30,000 fine against Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy and removal of the video from online platforms.

item.title: Roberto Carneiro deixa secretaria para atuar na campanha de Tarcísio
item.description: Roberto Carneiro will temporarily leave his position as head of the Government and Institutional Relations Secretariat of São Paulo state to focus on the re-election campaign of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, starting Monday (27/7). He is expected to return to the role on October 26, after the electoral period, with Marcelo de Oliveira serving as interim secretary.

item.title: Caiado diz que, se eleito, vai dar indulto a Bolsonaro: ‘Quero pacificar o País’
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD presidential candidate, reiterated that he would grant a pardon to former President Jair Bolsonaro if elected, stating he wants to pacify the country. He made the comment in a CNN interview, saying the initiative would be taken on his first day in office. Caiado criticized the polarization between the Lula government and bolsonarismo and noted Flavio Bolsonaro's declining poll numbers due to recent allegations.

item.title: Milei acusa Brasil, México e democratas dos EUA de financiar 'campanha anti-Argentina'
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei accused the governments of Brazil, Mexico, and the U.S. Democratic Party of funding an 'anti-Argentina' campaign without providing evidence, claiming 25% of the resources came from Brazil. He criticized the imprisonment of Jair Bolsonaro, called Alexandre de Moraes 'bald trash' and Lula a 'prisoner and thief' during a PL convention in São Paulo, where Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy was formalized. The Brazilian ambassador to Argentina was summoned for consultations amid rising bilateral tensions.

item.title: PT aciona TSE e Moraes por video de Bolsonaro com IA em ato do PL
item.description: The PT filed an electoral representation with the TSE and a factual report with Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes against an AI-generated video depicting Jair Bolsonaro endorsing his son Flávio Bolsonaro as his political successor. The party argues the deepfake violates electoral rules on synthetic media and circumvents a judicial order barring Bolsonaro from political expression. The video, shown at the PL’s national convention and streamed online, features an AI-generated Bolsonaro claiming he is 'imprisoned and silenced' and urging supporters to embrace Flávio as future president.

item.title: Os funcionários de Donald Trump que tiveram os vistos negados pelo governo Lula
item.description: The Lula government denied entry visas to U.S. officials Riley M. Barnes and Samuel D. Samson, who were scheduled to visit Brazil to discuss freedom of expression in the context of the 2026 elections. Barnes is the Under Secretary for Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor and Special Coordinator for Tibetan Affairs, while Samson is the Deputy Under Secretary and a key architect of the America First agenda. Itamaraty confirmed the visa denials but did not issue an official statement.

item.title: Rifado pelo DC, Aldo Rebelo sobe no palanque de Caiado
item.description: Former minister and federal deputy Aldo Rebelo attended the PSD national convention in São Paulo, which officially launched Ronaldo Caiado's presidential candidacy. During the event, Rebelo stated that Caiado's entry into the race 'elevates the quality of the debate' and suggested he could win an election even with limited initial resources.

item.title: Governo Lula convoca embaixador de Milei em meio a escalada de crise
item.description: The Brazilian government summoned Argentina's ambassador, Daniel Raimondi, to explain attacks by Argentine President Javier Milei against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and authorities of the Supreme Federal Court (STF). The move comes amid escalating diplomatic tensions between the two countries, with Raimondi possibly appearing at the Itamaraty Palace later today.

item.title: Caiado fala grosso, mas depende de um milagre para ser escutado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, campaigning since March, took four months to settle on a consistent political discourse. Initially, he attacked only Lula, sparing Flávio Bolsonaro. After his official candidacy was launched by the PSD this Sunday, he began harshly criticizing both, stating that 'whoever steals with the left hand or the right hand is a thief,' but this shift came too late to make a meaningful impact.

item.title: Lula diz não aceitar ingerência externa: “O Brasil sabe cuidar de si”
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that Brazil will not accept external interference in internal affairs, emphasizing that the country 'knows how to take care of itself'. He reiterated the maintenance of the economic strategy focused on growth, inflation reduction, and raising people's income, during a speech at the inauguration of the new leadership of the ABC Metalworkers' Union. Lula also linked the defense of sovereignty to the 2026 elections, warning that anyone who 'sticks their finger' in the Brazilian election 'will regret it'.

item.title: Lula e Tarcísio oficializam candidaturas; PL deve lançar Michelle ao Senado
item.description: Lula and Tarcísio de Freitas have officially confirmed their candidacies for the 2026 elections, solidifying the presidential race between the PT and the PL. The Liberal Party is expected to nominate Michelle Bolsonaro as its Senate candidate, while Flávio Bolsonaro has already launched his presidential bid, expanding the Bolsonaro family's presence in the race.

item.title: Caiado diz que Goiás não tem “MC Poze dando tiro” nem “Oruam”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), 2026 presidential candidate, stated at the PSD national convention in São Paulo that Goiás does not have artists like MC Poze and Oruam who incite violence, citing a drop in youths under socioeducational measures for drug trafficking from 1,073 to 198 during his governorship. He emphasized investments in vocational education and school retention, promising to replicate this model federally to combat crime, corruption, and the PT, while rejecting extremes and criticizing Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Zema quer Joaquim Barbosa de vice e espera selar acordo em agosto
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate for president, said he plans to meet retired Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa in August to discuss a potential vice-presidential ticket for 2026. Zema praised Barbosa as a 'ferocious fighter against corruption' and the opposite of some current justices, citing his role in the mensalão trial. The statement came one day before Novo's state convention in Minas Gerais and ahead of the party's national convention on July 27, 2026, when his candidacy is expected to be formalized.

item.title: A avaliação de dirigente do partido de Joaquim Barbosa sobre eventual dobradinha com Zema
item.description: João Caldas, national president of the Democracia Cristã party, expressed enthusiasm about the possibility of Joaquim Barbosa — a party affiliate and former STF minister who explored a presidential run — becoming the vice-presidential candidate on a ticket led by Romeu Zema (Novo). Caldas praised the potential pairing as a 'great ticket' and 'very good duo for Brazil,' saying he would sign on to it. Zema previously confirmed Barbosa is among the names being considered for the vice-presidential spot.

item.title: 'Brasil não aceita que ninguém meta o nariz onde não é chamado', diz Lula em meio a crise com Trump e Milei
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that Brazil will not tolerate foreign interference during the inauguration of the new president of the ABC Metalworkers' Union in São Bernardo do Campo. He linked the comment to recent tensions with the United States and Argentina, citing Trump's tariffs and attempts to monitor Brazilian elections, as well as Milei's insults. Lula emphasized Brazil's economic growth and investment attraction, such as BYD in Bahia, reinforcing national sovereignty.

item.title: PT aciona TSE contra Flávio por vídeo de IA de Bolsonaro
item.description: The PT, PV and PCdoB federation filed a complaint with the TSE against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and the PL over an AI-generated video simulating a speech by former President Jair Bolsonaro during the party convention. The action claims improper use of technology to create electoral disinformation.

item.title: Brasil chama a consultas seu embaixador na Argentina após 'ofensas' de Milei
item.description: Brazil recalled its ambassador to Argentina for consultations after Argentine President Javier Milei made offensive remarks against Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and other Brazilian officials during the Liberal Party (PL) convention in São Paulo. The Itamaraty announced the measure on Sunday (26) in response to what it deemed inappropriate statements.

item.title: PT pede ao TSE remoção de vídeo com IA de Bolsonaro em apoio a Flávio
item.description: The PT, PV and PCdoB federation has urged the TSE to immediately remove an AI-generated video showing Jair Bolsonaro endorsing Flávio Bolsonaro as his political successor, claiming it constitutes premature electoral propaganda and illegal use of deepfake technology. The video, aired at the PL’s national convention, states that the former president chose his son to continue his legacy, amounting to an illicit transfer of political capital. The federation argues the content violates TSE resolutions on synthetic media and that Jair Bolsonaro is barred from disseminating political-electoral manifestations, even through third parties.

item.title: PT aciona Moraes após vídeo de IA de Bolsonaro em convenção do PL
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) filed a request with Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, alleging that the display of an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro at the PL party convention violated judicial measures prohibiting the dissemination of political-electoral manifestos, including by third parties. The PT argues the video, similar to the previously analyzed 'Letter to Brazilians,' was broadcast live and widely shared online, constituting a breach of court order.

item.title: Lindbergh vai à PGR contra Flávio por Milei e IA de Bolsonaro em convenção do PL
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) filed a representation with the Attorney General’s Office (PGR) against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a presidential candidate, for inviting Argentine President Javier Milei to the PL national convention that formalized his candidacy. The petition alleges the invitation may constitute a crime, possibly related to foreign interference or improper use of political influence. The PGR will assess whether electoral laws or regulations on foreign support for campaigns were violated.

item.title: Lindbergh aciona PGR contra Flávio por vídeo de “Bolsonaro de IA”
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) filed a complaint with the Attorney General's Office (PGR) against presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) over an AI-generated video simulating a speech by former President Jair Bolsonaro during the PL convention. The PT lawmaker argues the use of AI was an attempt to circumvent legal restrictions imposed on the former president, potentially constituting abuse of power and electoral disinformation.

item.title: Kassab diz que não tinha “solo fértil” para acordo com União Brasil e PP
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, said there was no 'fertile ground' for an agreement with União Brasil and PP, leading to a pure PSD ticket with Ronaldo Caiado as presidential candidate and Kassab as vice. He accused other Centrão parties of being aligned with lulismo or bolsonarismo and ruled out alliances with Novo and Missão, as they also need their own candidates. The PSD ticket positions Caiado as a third-way alternative to Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Sem vaga no DC, Aldo Rebelo sobe em palanque de Caiado
item.description: Aldo Rebelo, former pre-candidate of the Christian Democracy party, joined the stage at the PSD convention that officially nominated Ronaldo Caiado for president and Gilberto Kassab as vice-president on July 26, 2026. Rebelo praised Caiado for possessing the biography to unite power and authority, stating he could reduce inequality, strengthen public security, overcome political division, and restore Brazil’s growth. Caiado, a 76-year-old orthopedic physician and former governor of Goiás, is seeking a return to the presidential race after joining the PSD in March 2026.

item.title: Ex-secretário de Segurança do governo Lula não crê em ataque de facções a candidatos à Presidência
item.description: Former National Public Security Secretary Mário Sarrubbo dismissed the likelihood of attacks by criminal factions such as PCC and Comando Vermelho against presidential candidates, stating that organized crime in Brazil is more negotiational than violent in the political sphere and that assassinations would disrupt their illegal businesses. He noted that while local cells may issue isolated threats, national leadership orders for assassinations are unlikely. Entrepreneur Renan Santos (Missão) of the MBL announced his presidential candidacy with a request for Federal Police protection, citing death threats received during visits to Ceará and Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Tarcísio detalha estragos após ventos de 160 km/h em Ribeirão Preto
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas visited Ribeirão Preto after a storm with 160 km/h winds caused death and damage to agribusiness, schools, and infrastructure. He detailed losses in storage facilities, sugarcane fields, and orchards, and announced humanitarian aid and FEAP fund releases to mitigate impacts. Tarcísio also emphasized the difficulty in predicting wind intensity despite investments in meteorological radars.

item.title: Em Ribeirão Preto, Tarcísio comenta temporal que provocou destruição na região: 'Evento sem precedentes'
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas visited Ribeirão Preto after a severe storm caused significant damage, including the loss of 54 transmission towers and winds reaching up to 160 km/h, according to IAC measurements. He announced emergency measures such as humanitarian aid, roof tiles, water trucks, funds for school reconstruction, and support for the agribusiness sector, plus a R$150 million investment in eight new meteorological radars to improve forecasting of extreme weather events.

item.title: Alvo de ofensiva de pré-candidatos, Podemos deve ficar neutro na corrida presidencial
item.description: Podemos is expected to remain neutral in the 2026 Brazilian presidential race, according to allies of its national president, Renata Abreu, as no current candidacy aligns with the party's principles. Although the party has received overtures from PL (via Flavio Bolsonaro) and Novo (via Romeu Zema) for a potential vice-presidential ticket, Podemos prioritizes strengthening its legislative bench and follows the stance of parties like PP, União Brasil and Republicanos, which also indicate they will not endorse any presidential candidate.

item.title: Lindbergh, do PT, aciona PGR contra Flavio Bolsonaro por uso de IA e Milei em convenção do PL
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) filed a request with the Attorney General's Office (PGR) to investigate presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for allegedly using a deepfake of former president Jair Bolsonaro generated by Artificial Intelligence, displayed at the PL's convention last Saturday. The PT lawmaker claims improper use of image and potential electoral disinformation.

item.title: Presidente do PDT diz que partido tem "grata satisfação" por deixar base de Simões
item.description: The president of the PDT in Minas Gerais, federal deputy Mário Heringer, celebrated the departure of state deputy Carlos Henrique (now in the Republicans) from the party and the party's decision to leave the base of Governor Mateus Simões in the ALMG, stating it brings 'great satisfaction'. He also noted that his personal friend Thiago Cota will not run for office again. Heringer reaffirmed the PDT's support for an independent candidacy of Alexandre Kalil for Minas Gerais governor, despite the national party backing Lula's re-election, to avoid state-level polarization.

item.title: Os apelidos que Caiado usa para se referir a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: During the convention that formalized his presidential candidacy, Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) used two nicknames to refer to Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) without naming him directly: first calling him a 'kinder egg candidate, a little surprise every day', alluding to scandals such as the R$134 million request to Daniel Vorcaro for the Dark Horse film, a photo alongside 'Sicário', and fiscal notes disclosed by Metrópoles; later he called him a 'farm-raised chicken', implying Flávio relies on Jair Bolsonaro to explain his actions. Caiado aims to attract PL voters by criticizing Flávio’s candidacy, with whom he competes in the same political space, in an effort to reach the runoff.

item.title: Caiado promete confiscar patrimônio de agressor e transferir à mulher
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD presidential candidate, announced that if elected, he would confiscate the assets of individuals convicted of violence against women and transfer them to the victims and their children, while maintaining harsh penalties without reduction. He pledged a 'heavy hand' approach to combat rape and domestic violence, including the use of ankle monitors and handcuffs against perpetrators, stating this would be a hallmark of his potential presidency. The statement was made ahead of the PSD convention in São Paulo, which formally nominated his ticket with Gilberto Kassab as vice-presidential candidate.

item.title: Unidade Popular oficializa candidatura de Samara Martins à Presidência da República
item.description: The Popular Unity party officially nominated dentist Samara Martins as its presidential candidate, with port worker Raquel Brício as her running mate, forming a 100% female socialist ticket. Martins, running for president for the second time, emphasized in her speech the fight against gender-based violence and the defense of workers' rights. The party also announced gubernatorial candidates in 17 states, including Vivian Mendes in São Paulo.

item.title: Lula volta a dizer que não aceita ingerência em meio a tensão com Trump
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) reiterated his rejection of any foreign interference in Brazil, stating the country knows how to take care of itself. His remarks came during the swearing-in of the president of the ABC Metal Workers’ Union, amid tensions with the U.S. government, including tariffs of up to 37.5% on Brazilian exports and the denial of visas to U.S. officials allegedly seeking to undermine the electoral process.
